chapter_title: SCOMET: Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies
title: Record Keeping
text: 10.18 Record Keeping Every SCOMET export authorisation holder (including for GAICT and GAEC) shall maintain all the relevant records, including all the documents submitted while making an application for SCOMET Authorisation, in manual or electronic form, for a period of 5 years or till validity of export authorisation, whichever is higher, from the date of export or import, as applicable.
intent: Support Record Keeping processing and compliance validation.
